scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm electron:typecheck && vite build && pnpm electron:build
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite" "wait-on tcp:5273 && electron . http://127.0.0.1:5273"
scripts.electron:pack:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.electron:dist:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.publish.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.electron:dist:win:dry: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
